name: Kael
notes: Kavi's child, a master valve-artisan who left the Lothal trade houses' expectations behind to live as the man he was. He anchored the archive cart with a crowbar on the day the ground broke at the Great Junction Drydock, forged tools and copper pipes from scrap aboard the stranded Kelpfang-II, bore twins in the golden season that followed, and died defending their cradle on the Night of Red Teeth. Ananya burned him on a cedar pyre in his smith's apron with Kavi's calipers on his chest. One of the Founding Three.
